sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Unlike other melee weapons, the knife is lost upon death and lootable by other players, even if it's equipped in the sheath (melee) slot
- When an enemy is struck by the knife, it inflicts the effect, dealing gradual damage over time (140 HP/minute). Immunity lowers the amount of damage at 1% per level. It can be treated with xTG-12 injector or Perfotoran injector.
- The knife has 2 uses. This means that only the first two hits inflict the effect.
